description.value:
Prerequisite: Tidally Locked Eclipse World, Void Wreck, or Shadow Moon

Acclimated to absolute light deprivation and the dim fringes of dead sectors.

  • Necrotic Insulator: You have Resistance to Necrotic damage.
  • Shadow Stalker: You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws, and you can attempt to take the Hide action while in a Lightly Obscured area, even while in a creature's line of sight.

system.requirements: Tidally Locked Eclipse World, Void Wreck, or Shadow Moon
